description: This PHP class 'CoreOAuthPluginConfiguration' implements plugin configuration for the OAuth plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It initializes services and event subscribers related to OAuth by registering dependencies into a service container and adding an event subscriber.

classes.name: CoreOAuthPluginConfiguration
classes.description: A class that configures OAuth plugin services and event subscriptions during plugin initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth plugin by registering core services (PSR HTTP factory, OAuth server, OAuth service) and adding an OAuth event subscriber.
